**UI Audit: EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free**

### 1) LAYOUT
*   **Window:** 1024x768 (Maximized, standard Windows 11 chrome).
*   **Title Bar (0, 0 - 1024, 45):** App icon + title (left), Action cluster (right).
*   **Toolbar Cluster (0, 60 - 1024, 115):**
    *   Navigation Group (Home/Back/Forward/Up) at [15, 70].
    *   Address Bar [165, 68] to [290, 108] with "Windows (C:)".
    *   View Controls (List icon, Filter button) at [650, 75].
    *   Search Box [785, 72] to [985, 110].
*   **Main Content Area (0, 120 - 1024, 855):**
    *   **Left Pane (Tree View):** [5, 130] to [275, 845]. Contains Path/Type tabs and folder tree.
    *   **Center Pane (File List):** [285, 130] to [795, 845]. Contains column headers and item rows.
    *   **Right Pane (Preview/Details):** [805, 130] to [990, 845]. Shows file preview and metadata.
*   **Status/Footer Bar (0, 856 - 1024, 940):**
    *   Status Message (left) with checkmark icon.
    *   Primary CTA "Recover All ..." (right).
*   **Windows Taskbar (0, 941 - 1024, 1000).**

### 2) TEXT (Verbatim)
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Address Bar:** `Windows (C:)`
*   **Tabs:** `Path`, `Type`
*   **Tree Items:** `Windows (C:)`, `File Path Lost`, `Reconstructed`
*   **Tree Counts:** `1.1M`, `4.2K`, `90`
*   **Column Headers:** `Name` (with sort arrow), `Date Modified`, `Type`
*   **File List Rows:**
    *   `actionarchivecache` | `10/7/2026 11:30 PM` | `File folde...`
    *   `actions-runner` | `10/17/2026 6:09 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `azureCli` | `10/8/2026 1:50 AM` | `File folder`
    *   `cobertura-2.1.1` | `2/26/2015 11:23 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `ghcup` (Selected) | `10/8/2026 12:32 AM` | `File folder`
    *   `hostedtoolcache` | ...
    *   `image` | ...
    *   `inetpub` | ...
    *   `Julia` | ...
    *   `mingw32` | `2/19/2026 12:59 PM` | `File folder`
*   **Right Pane:** `ghcup`, `Open`, `Size`, `4.23 GB`, `Modified`, `10/8/2026 12:32 AM`
*   **Context Menu (Open on 'ghcup'):**
    *   `Recover`
    *   `Preview`
    *   `Open file location`
    *   `Select unrecovered files`
    *   `Smart select best files`
    *   `Clear selection`
*   **Status Bar:** `Scan Completed, Files Found: 1139165 (146.58 GB)`
*   **CTA Button:** `Recover All ...`

### 3) COLOR (Hex Estimates)
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   App Background / Panes: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Selected Row (Center): `#E3F2FD` (Light Blue)
    *   Context Menu BG: `#FFFFFF`
    *   Taskbar: `#F3F3F3`
*   **Accents & Text:**
    *   Primary Brand Blue (Button, Icons, Links): `#2D7FF9`
    *   Button Hover/Active Gradient (CTA): Linear gradient from `#2979FF` to `#1565C0`.
    *   Standard Text (Primary): `#333333` or `#000000`
    *   Secondary/Muted Text (Dates, Sizes, Tree counts): `#666666` or `#888888`
    *   Disabled Text (Context menu items like 'Preview'/'Open location'): `#AAAAAA`
*   **Borders:**
    *   Input Fields / Buttons: `#D1D1D1` or `#CCCCCC`
    *   Separator Lines (Tree/List dividers): `#EEEEEE`

### 4) TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Font Family:** Segoe UI (Standard Windows UI font).
*   **Sizes:**
    *   Title Bar: 12px (Regular).
    *   Tree Items / File List Items: 13-14px (Regular).
    *   Column Headers: 12-13px (Regular).
    *   Status Bar Message: 14px (Semi-bold or Bold for the numbers).
    *   CTA Button: 14px (Medium/Bold).
    *   Context Menu: 13px.

### 5) SPACING & SIZING
*   **Row Height (File List):** ~42px - 46px.
*   **Icon Size (Folder/File):** 24x24px or 32x32px inside the list row.
*   **Control Heights:**
    *   Toolbar Buttons: 32px.
    *   Search Box / Address Bar: 36px.
    *   Tabs: 32px height.
    *   CTA Button ("Recover All"): 40px height.
*   **Padding/Gutters:**
    *   Left pane padding: ~16px.
    *   List Item Indent: ~20px per level.
    *   Column Header Padding: ~10px vertical.
*   **Radii:**
    *   Buttons/Search Box: 4px - 6px (Rounded corners).
    *   Context Menu: 8px.
    *   Selection Highlight: 4px - 6px.

### 6) CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Navigation:** Home (Icon), Back (Disabled/Grey), Forward (Disabled/Grey), Up (Enabled).
*   **View Toggle:** List view selected (indicated by blue highlight on the icon).
*   **Filter Button:** Normal state.
*   **Search Box:** Placeholder text "Search files or folders", Search Icon (right aligned).
*   **Tabs:** "Path" is Active (White bg, top border/shadow), "Type" is Inactive (Grey bg).
*   **Tree View:**
    *   Expand/Collapse arrows (Chevron right/down).
    *   Checkboxes next to items (Unchecked).
*   **File List:**
    *   Checkbox column (Square, unchecked).
    *   Sort Indicator: Up arrow on "Name" column.
    *   Row State: "ghcup" row is **Selected** (Light blue background).
*   **Context Menu (Overlay):**
    *   Triggered by Right-click on "ghcup".
    *   Items: "Recover" (Normal), "Preview" (Disabled/Grey), "Open file location" (Disabled), "Select unrecovered files" (Checked radio-style), "Smart select best files" (Disabled), "Clear selection" (Disabled).
*   **Right Pane:**
    *   Preview Area: Large Folder Icon.
    *   Action Button: "Open" (Blue outline style? No, looks light blue fill).
*   **Bottom Bar:**
    *   Success Icon (Checkmark in circle).
    *   "Recover All..." Button: Primary state (Solid Blue).

### 7) ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Fluent Design / Segoe Fluent Icons.
*   **Weights:**
    *   Outline: Back/Forward arrows, Filter funnel, Search magnifier, Sort arrow.
    *   Filled/Solid: Home icon, Folder icons (Yellow/Blue), Checkmark (Success), App Logo.
*   **Specifics:**
    *   Folders in tree are standard yellow folders.
    *   Folders in list are standard yellow folders.
    *   Preview area shows a large blue folder outline/filled hybrid icon.

### 8) STATE
*   **Page State:** **Success / Data Loaded**.
    *   The scan has completed (`Scan Completed` message is visible).
    *   Data is populated in the tree and list views.
    *   A user interaction (Right-click context menu) is currently active, overlaying the content.
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible (static screenshot), but the context menu implies an active modal interaction state.
